classifier.validation: next cyclic outer fold; source CNN trained on remaining three folds
classifier.inner_folds: three existing training folds; one at a time held out; excludes cyclic validation and outer test
classifier.retention: MacroF1 paired lower95 bound>0; no point decrease in any class F1; at least3of5 folds improved; no formal switch in this round

occlusion.region_definition: intersection of the annotated interval with each view on both axes, excluding distance<2; proxy, not an annotated contact-pixel segmentation
occlusion.control_definition: same row/column diagonal-distance histogram, outside annotated square, supported in both repeats; infeasible cells retained
